mapper.select: SELECT id, provider, base_url, api_key, model_name, config_name, sort, temperature, is_active, max_tokens, model_type, completions_path, embeddings_path, created_time, updated_time, is_deleted, proxy_enabled, proxy_host, proxy_port, proxy_username, proxy_password FROM luck_model_config WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, created_time DESC

SELECT id, provider, base_url, api_key, model_name, config_name, sort, temperature, is_active, max_tokens, model_type, completions_path, embeddings_path, created_time, updated_time, is_deleted, proxy_enabled, proxy_host, proxy_port, proxy_username, proxy_password FROM luck_model_config WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, provider, base_url, api_key, model_name, config_name, sort, temperature, is_active, max_tokens, model_type, completions_path, embeddings_path, created_time, updated_time, is_deleted, proxy_enabled, proxy_host, proxy_port, proxy_username, proxy_password FROM luck_model_config WHERE model_type = #{modelType} AND is_active = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM luck_model_config WHERE model_type = #{modelType} AND is_active = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_model_config (id, provider, base_url, api_key, model_name, config_name, sort, temperature, is_active, max_tokens, model_type, completions_path, embeddings_path, created_time, updated_time, is_deleted, proxy_enabled, proxy_host, proxy_port, proxy_username, proxy_password) VALUES (#{id}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{modelName}, #{configName}, #{sort}, #{temperature}, CASE WHEN #{isActive} IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{maxTokens}, #{modelType}, #{completionsPath}, #{embeddingsPath}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, 0, CASE WHEN #{proxyEnabled} IS TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{proxyHost}, #{proxyPort}, #{proxyUsername}, #{proxyPassword})
mapper.update: UPDATE luck_model_config SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
